description: Informedness / alpha reputation of a Solana wallet, scored OUT-OF-SAMPLE: does this wallet's BUY tend to PRECEDE price-up moves? Proprietary metric from our tracked universe (1000+ wallets, cross-coin). Returns informedness_med / informedness_mean (how much its buys lead price, %), n (sample size), rel_score. Use it to weight copy-trading, rank a signal source, or screen a counterparty's informedness. Higher = more informed / price-leading; negative = its buys tend to precede DROPS. Free 10/day, then $0.01/call.
name: wallet_reputation
